notes:
Inbound self-serve signup (trial) — early discovery, sees latency spikes across regions.

Summary: HummingBay is an e-commerce personalization provider building personalized product carousels and chat support. Signed up via self-serve on 2026-01-20, started hitting p95 latency 500-900ms for chat endpoints during peak; target for UX is <200-300ms. Mostly NA HQ but sizable EU customer base; majority of production traffic surfaces from EU during business hours.

Recent activity:
- 2026-01-20: Self-serve sign-up, used default region (us-east-1) and default model.
- 2026-01-28: Support ticket INF-4021 opened: "slow responses on chat p95". Provided request IDs and sample logs.
- 2026-02-02: Quick triage call w/ AE Alex K. — reproduced higher latency from EU, suggested switching to eu-west region and enabling streaming. (ff call id ff_2026-02-10_1642 contains longer transcript).
- 2026-02-10: SE Jordan ran short perf test with synthetic load; found tokenization and large prompt context (avg prompt 1,800 tokens) driving KV-cache misses and longer runtimes. Suggested prompt trimming and using summaries for prior context.
- 2026-02-12: Follow-up email with recommended config: region -> eu-west, streaming = on, client timeout = 20s, model variant = low-latency quantized when appropriate. Shared quick checklist (drive:/HummingBay/Redwood_Perf_Recap_2026-02-10.pdf).

Key technical notes / recommendations given so far (paraphrased):
- Region choice: route EU traffic to eu-west to reduce network RTT; enable region-aware routing in client if using global CDN.
- Timeouts: set client-side timeout to 18-25s for chat flows; abort/visibility on stalled token generation.
- Prompt guidance: reduce context length, move long histories to summary embeddings, cap system+history to ~800 tokens where possible.
- Streaming: enable streaming to improve perceived latency for end-users; allows UI to render partial tokens while generation continues.
- Model variants & batching: offer smaller quantized variant for low-latency paths; use batching for embeddings and reranking offline.
- Caching: enable response/prefix caching for repeated similar prompts to cut downstream compute.

Quotes / customer color: "Users notice a delay when they try quick answers — drops conversions."

Open items / blockers:
- HummingBay's payments/integration stack (third-party CDN & auth) currently pinned to a US region; need to confirm with their infra team before switching region.
- CFO flagged cost if we recommend larger models; wants ARR impact estimate.
